visual.description: Fixed top navigation bar with logo left, centered menu links, and auth CTAs (Log in + Sign up button) on the right.
Full-width dark hero with large left-aligned headline text, subtitle below left, and a 'New' badge + link floated to the right at subtitle level.
Centered floating app UI card overlapping into the next section, showing a 3-column split inside: left sidebar, main content panel, right metadata panel.
Horizontal row of 7 customer logos evenly distributed across the full width on a dark background.
Single large statement headline spanning full width with the second half of the sentence rendered in a lighter gray tone for visual hierarchy.
Three equal-width cards labeled FIG 0.2, 0.3, 0.4 containing isometric diagram illustrations, arranged in a uniform grid row.
Two-column layout with a large bold left headline ('Make product operations self-driving') and right-aligned descriptive paragraph with a numbered link below.
Two overlapping UI screenshots side by side — a chat thread card on the left and a kanban board on the right — positioned below the 2-column headline section.
Two-column layout with bold left headline ('Define the product direction') and right descriptive text with a versioned link, above a timeline/roadmap UI screenshot.
Two UI panels side by side: a left project list with initiative groupings and issue counts, and a right roadmap timeline chart with milestone markers.
Two-column layout with left headline ('Move work forward across teams and agents') and right descriptive paragraph with a numbered link.
Two UI panels: a left terminal-style agent log view and a right assignee picker dropdown, both floating on a dark background.
Two-column section with left headline ('Review PRs and agent output') and right descriptive text, with a code diff panel visible below spanning the full width.
Full-width side-by-side code diff view showing two versions of a TypeScript file with red/green line highlights indicating changes.
Two-column section with left headline ('Understand progress at scale') paired with right explanatory text and a numbered link.
Two floating UI panels: a left 'Weekly Pulse' report card and a right scatter plot analytics chart labeled 'Cycle time by agent'.
Four equal-width release cards in a row, each with a small thumbnail, title, description, and date label below.
Two large quote cards side by side — one pale blue/lavender and one bright yellow — with black serif text, creating a strong color-block contrast layout.
Full-width dark section with a centered large headline ('Built for the future. Available today.') and two CTA buttons centered below.
Footer divided into 6 columns: logo on far left, then Product, Features, Company, Resources, and Connect link groups evenly spaced.

_twist.description: Container max-width expanded 1436px -> 1600px (~+11%) for a wider, composed widescreen canvas. Linear's generous 77px gutters retained to read as cinema-projection margins. No color or grid-structure changes.
